auth.mechanism: none: GET /api/brandsList is a public endpoint

rules.text: GET /api/brandsList returns the brand of every catalogue product, one entry per product: entry id is the product id and brand is that product's brand. A brand appears once per product it has; the distinct brand names are our brands.
Like the rest of the public catalogue API, brandsList always answers with HTTP status 200 and reports the outcome in the responseCode field of its JSON body.
Contact Us form fields (mock-up): Name (optional), Email (mandatory, marked *), Subject (optional), Message (optional), Attachment (optional, not part of this story).
The form must not be sent while a mandatory field is empty or the e-mail is not a valid address.

Submit flow (mock-up): Submit -> browser confirmation "Press OK to proceed!" -> OK shows the green success banner above the form and replaces the form with a "Home" button. Cancel keeps the form as filled, no banner.

errorModel.case: Unsupported method (PUT, POST or DELETE) on /api/brandsList
errorModel.body: responseCode 405 with message "This request method is not supported."

testData.strategy: No seeding: brand checks read the existing catalogue through GET /api/brandsList and GET /api/productsList (brand data comes from the same catalogue as the products); Contact Us tests type their own input into the form.
